_comment: FA-07 gate 10 (omega#26) producer claim for 0.2.0-rc13. Input to omega script/review-omega-candidate. The reviewer recomputes every value below from the artifact and the installed application; it never reads the producer's evidence. A gap is stated in _producerIdentityGap rather than papered over.
_producerIdentityGap: No producer keypair is registered anywhere in AUTHORITY.md; producers hold role operating_agent, not a key. script/review-omega-candidate only refuses when the reviewer key appears in producerPubkeys, so a producer that named itself dishonestly would pass that check. The identifier below is descriptive, not cryptographic. Naming this rather than minting a plausible-looking hex string, because a fake pubkey here would make the independence check look stronger than it is.
